purpose: Reach and measure a practical conditional color-representation limit of the existing ordinary road GS, without validation-driven hyperparameter search.
user_authorization: 2026-11-20: proceed autonomously according to new findings, aim for3DGS representation limit, do not overfit/tune; keepGPUon.

interpretation.ceiling: same fixed geometry/covariance/opacity/scope and registered convex image objective; not a universal3DGS or perceptual optimum theorem
interpretation.visual_acceptance: multi-axis frozen quality bench, not optimization convergence or a low color MAE
interpretation.primary_reader: physical Sigma GH31 world-field average to oneRGB perGaussian, actual native1920 raster; pixel-world shader is endpoint diagnostic only

data.C: frozen hole pseudo teacher, not hidden-road truth
data.split: 2m worldXY cells at origin0, SHA256(scene065|101|bx|by) first8bytes big-endian modulo5==0 held, no salt retries
data.new_label_exclusion: seen-only context/score for all normalization and updates; HF/Sobel kernels only consume seen-context labels
data.held: prior-conditioned spatial residual-learning diagnostic, NOT blind; old A0/A200/routing previously saw both teachers
data.local_coupling: physical GS Sigma and shared-field halo may transfer updates across held boundaries; no parameter-isolation claim
data.validation_policy: never choose step, learning rate, loss weight, frequency, or checkpoint using held or diagnostic quality

init.high: exact zero, no oldM11H warm start
init.permission: explicit final teacher mH_union, not overwritten by A200 original buffers
init.common_ci0: same physicalSigma read of L_A200/H0, readonly parent ci exact

shared_parameterization.H: 0.17*(tanh(Hraw)-Gaussian_sigma3cells(tanh(Hraw))); original finite support and teacher output gate
shared_parameterization.extra_H_lowpass: none: native source footprints are anisotropic and minor axes commonly below lattice texel; physicalSigma integrates actualGS footprints
shared_parameterization.gradients: only low/high fields; readonly rows stay exact

objective.signal: E=(native premult roadP - fixedalpha*T)*fixedInvAlpha on commonalpha>=.95; fixed inverse<=1/.95, no low-opacity optimization division
objective.domains: A/C/S independently normalized on fixed seen score/core, full pre-alpha coverage denominator retained in evaluation
objective.frames: full batch both views equally weighted peraccepted update
terms: mean of signed mask-safeHF squared at sigma1/2/4 native pixels
objective.term_normalization: one-shot perview/source/component initialci0 residual mean-square, lowerbounded(1/255)^2; no held labels/statistics
objective.oracle: same DETAIL dataobjective in the relaxed bounded independentci space
objective.convexity: only oracle ci and fixed affine native rendering; field tanh/clamp parameterization not convex

G_ORACLE.solver: monotone projected gradient with quadratic-majorization backtracking
G_ORACLE.stopping: at checks every100steps, measuredFWgap/max(objective,1e-3)<=.01; this is a numeric diagnostic, not a strict certificate without global gradient error bound
G_ORACLE.continuation: one exact2000-step continuation if not numerically converged; cap4000accepted total, no LR/loss/split change
G_ORACLE.promotion: not automatically promoted; seen-color relaxation only, held and novel-view failures retained

IDEAL_ORACLE.source_I: union of legal A/C/S source regions, known analytic synthetic material, not realA labels
IDEAL_ORACLE.target: readonly_roadRGB + actualeligible_road_alphaT * independent continuousworld ideal_pixelAA; never multiplypremult targetalpha twice
IDEAL_ORACLE.context: known available worldfunction, source legal region, roadalpha>=.95 and eligible roadWe>=.95
IDEAL_ORACLE.supervision: all qualified analytic source pixels; these analytic labels are open, not held generalization or real hiddenGT
IDEAL_ORACLE.comparison: conditional mechanism control, not a fourth method ranked against realteacher validation
IDEAL_ORACLE.structural_gate: existing0.90 contrast retention for12cmpaint separately measured; loss optimum alone cannot prove no boxci passes this gate

engineering.preflight: 8F/2B zero parameterupdates already separate, zeroL/H engineeringinitial not formalci0
engineering.profile: onebounded full-objective checkpoint/replay/stage-entry/persistence profile; discard states
engineering.long_smoke: if conservative whole formalqueue estimate is about1hour or longer, run about10min actual lifecycle smoke beforeformal; count all duplicate/engineering steps separately
engineering.short_smoke: if demonstrably below1hour, complete realnative backward+CSRCUDA+save/eval/completeAdam+solverRNG restore+nextstep+BtoC+persistentreload; CPUtests never replace it
engineering.engineering_fixes: preserve failed directories, exact-state restore or cleanreplay, keep methods/budgets unchanged; record extra calls and source revisions

evaluation.steps: report fixed final endpoints; intermediate checkpoints are diagnostic only, no best-val selection
evaluation.masks: train seen / prior-conditioned held / fullprealpha coverage separately
evaluation.K: fresh actual1920 per-view mask/weight and finalRGB protection; never copy screen pixels or silently shrinkscope
evaluation.persistence: each arm emits effective boundedci and unchanged geometry/provenance plus common reader/fieldstate as applicable; public reload before allfinal eval
evaluation.no_supervised_signal_for_Gs_missing_or_s: report these independently, do not hide them in material-only score
evaluation.acceptance: no blanketqualityPASS fromconvex gap; vector detail+falseHF+edge+realpaint+coverage+K+jointscene evidence retained

anti_tuning.representation_scope_changes: none in primaryphase; any future density change needs an explicitly source-defined recipe, newK/coverage proof and separate comparison, never a silent retry
